entries.title: Joshua 15:1
segments: God will peculiarly bless those who are faithful in his service, and bestow upon them all needed good.

entries.title: Joshua 15:2
segments:
vv 2-4. 
 
  And their south border--south coast; these verses contain an accurate description of the south border of Judah, which was also the southern limit of Canaan west of the Arabab, a long narrow valley running south from the Dead sea.  Beginning from the southern bay of the Dead sea, it ran south about eight miles to Maaleh-acrabbim, a line of chalk hills running east and west across the Arabah.  Thence it passed south and west to Kadesh-barnea.  Thence it was carried in a general westerly direction to "the river of Egypt" at Rhinocolura.

entries.title: Joshua 15:5
segments: End of Jordan; its mouth, at the Dead sea.

entries.title: Joshua 15:6
segments:
vv 6-11. 
 
These places lay along a line from near the north end of the Dead sea west, by Jerusalem, to Ekron in the land of the Philistines.

entries.title: Joshua 15:7
segments: En-rogel; a well in the valley of Kidron a little distance south of Jerusalem.

entries.title: Joshua 15:8
segments: Valley of the son of Hinnom; this valley begins on the west of Jerusalem, and sweeps around its south-west corner--the ancient Zion-- entering the valley of Kidron just below the city.  Thus Jerusalem itself belonged not to Judah, but to Benjamin.

entries.title: Joshua 15:13
segments: God never forgets his promises, and in due time those who trust in him will experience their fulfilment.

entries.title: Joshua 15:15
segments: Debir; a city west of Hebron, and south-west of Jerusalem.

entries.title: Joshua 15:17
segments: It is a great privilege to be connected in marriage with pious families; and where the will of God is duly regarded in forming this connection, it may be expected to promote the respectability, usefulness, and comfort of all concerned.

entries.title: Joshua 15:19
segments:
A south land; one that was warm and comparatively without water. 
 
  The upper springs, and the nether; high and low grounds that were well watered.

entries.title: Joshua 15:21
segments:
vv 21-62. 
 
The places here mentioned lay in the south part of Canaan, in that portion which was allotted to Judah; a part of which was afterwards given to the tribe of Simeon.

entries.title: Joshua 15:32
segments: Twenty and nine; thirty-eight are mentioned; but nine, it is supposed, were given to Simeon, leaving twenty-nine for Judah.

entries.title: Joshua 15:36
segments: Fourteen cities; fifteen names are mentioned, but two are supposed to belong to one city, or to it and its suburbs.
